difference.candidate_requirement: After a complete authenticated HTTP request has been read, monitor the peer connection for RST or another socket error and cancel the connection-scoped request token promptly. Cancellation must interrupt an in-flight PostgreSQL report query, release the process-local generation guard, join request work, and produce no DNS, Redis, Maildir, or source-database side effect. A clean FIN, unread data followed by FIN, or request write half-close is not an abort signal and must not cancel a valid response.
difference.oracle_behavior: After receiving a complete authenticated POST /api/reports/trigger, the frozen Java controller keeps the generation future and process-local guard alive after TCP RST. A later trigger returns the normal zero-count Already running response until the retained database query completes.
difference.reason: Retaining connection-owned work after the client is gone can indefinitely occupy the only report-generation permit when a dependency is slow or half-open. The rewrite requires deadlines and cancellation to propagate through database work and release bounded admission promptly.
difference.scope: Only peer RST or another socket error after a complete authenticated report-trigger request while its generation is still in flight. Clean FIN and request write half-close, a connected request, ordinary concurrent admission, report ordering and bytes, all successful side effects, error summaries, scheduler ownership, and non-disconnect database behavior remain exact compatibility requirements.

contract.transport: TCP RST after a complete authenticated POST /api/reports/trigger request
contract.oracle_behavior: The blocked PostgreSQL query and process-local generation guard remain active; an overlapping trigger returns Already running.
contract.candidate_behavior: TCP RST or another socket error cancels the blocked PostgreSQL query, joins connection-owned work, releases the guard, and allows a retry to reach PostgreSQL before the lock is released. Clean FIN and request write half-close do not cancel the response.
